summary: Single PR #1 (order matters; libs/ are inlined at build time so the stricter contract would break any app still lacking owner). validateApp now throws on missing/blank owner (lib bumped to 2.0.0, breaking). Billing=payments, core-shell=platform, reports=insights (reports also called validateApp but had no ticket; fixed so it won't break on next build). Owners taken from each app's package.json 'team'. All three apps build locally; CI and CD green.
